notes.title: Let's celebrate FuryDough release and eat donuts together!!!
🔥 🎉 The Dough Has Risen! FuryDough is Here! 🎉 🔥🤪
notes.content:
Two long years, countless hours... and way too many donuts. 🍩 Fueled by sugar and a dream, I devoured them all while crafting this game.

But don’t worry—I saved a few for you! 
Actually, hordes of crazy donuts. 🕹️ Grab FuryDough now, almost for free (cheaper than your morning coffee), and dive into a roguelite adventure baked with love, chaos, and just the right amount of glaze.

Don’t let this one get stale—your next adventure is fresh out of the oven! 🍞

[h1]Buy and play FuryDough Now![/h1]

notes.title: FuryDough Demo is coming
notes.content:
📢 Big news, everyone! 🎮

FuryDough Demo build has been uploaded and is currently awaiting review on Steam! 🚀 
After a year of tirelessly developing both the concept and code, with the invaluable contribution of a talented pixel art artist, I'm thrilled to give you a sneak peek into what's been brewing.

This short demo represents a labor of love, where every pixel and line of code has been carefully crafted to create an unforgettable experience. As a solo developer with a vision, it's been a journey filled with challenges, and I can't wait for you to embark on it with me.

But the journey doesn't end here. To stay in the loop and ensure you never miss out on any updates or announcements, be sure to Wishlist and Follow FuryDough on Steam. 
Your support means the world to me as I continue to bring this dream to fruition.

Thank you for being a part of this incredible adventure. 
Together, let's make FuryDough something truly remarkable! 🌟
